episode_title: Your Next Guest Is Asking ChatGPT First | S2 EP 23

real_qa.q: How do restaurant guests find restaurants through ChatGPT and Gemini instead of traditional search?
real_qa.r: Guests now ask AI assistants questions and receive short lists, sometimes just one name, rather than searching and scrolling through lists themselves. When they ask questions, AI assistants can only recommend restaurants they can describe with confidence based on available information. Restaurant owners not appearing on those AI recommendation lists become invisible to potential guests.
real_qa.requete: how guests find restaurants ChatGPT Gemini

real_qa.q: What are the three steps to make your restaurant easier for AI assistants to describe?
real_qa.r: Step one is Ask: test how AI assistants currently describe your restaurant by prompting ChatGPT or Gemini with your cuisine and restaurant name to identify missing, wrong, or vague information. Step two is Match: write one sentence describing your restaurant and ensure that description is consistent across five places—Google Business Profile, website, online ordering page, delivery apps, and social media bios, including matching hours, address, phone number, and spelling. Step three is Feed: provide AI systems with detailed menu descriptions using plain language, ingredients, dietary options, real replies to reviews in your own voice, and real photos of your best sellers.

real_qa.q: What is Order with Google and how does it work with Toast Online Ordering?
real_qa.r: Order with Google is a free feature included with Toast Online Ordering that lets guests order from your Toast Ordering page directly through Google Search and Maps. It turns on automatically when online ordering is enabled unless your Google Business Profile has opted out of food ordering. There is no commission charged. To enable it, go to Toast's takeout and delivery section, then Google management, preview your Google Listings, and save to Google; changes take up to 48 hours to appear.
real_qa.requete: Order with Google Toast Online Ordering

real_qa.q: What three requirements must be met for guests to order through Google from Toast?
real_qa.r: A Google Business Profile that has not opted out of food ordering, visible online ordering menus, and the online ordering toggle switched on in your Toast account. Additionally, menu items without photos may display guest-uploaded images instead, so adding your own photos ensures your restaurant is presented with images you control.

real_qa.q: How should restaurant owners measure whether being easier to describe in AI results is generating real orders?
real_qa.r: Rather than judging success by screenshots of AI answers which change daily, watch two concrete numbers over the next two weeks: direct orders and commissions paid. These metrics reveal whether being easier to describe is actually converting into real customer orders from AI-driven discovery.
real_qa.requete: measure AI description results restaurant orders
